title: Service definition
description: A static-key API a run may call with a stored secret: its hosts, the paths a value is set on, how the value is sent, and the secrets it needs. A service connection names its definition and links each declared secret; the run configuration's service item is rendered from the definition. Built-in definitions ship in priv/services; a workspace may write its own.

key.description: The definition's key, unique among the built-in definitions, and among a workspace's own.

hosts.description: Exact DNS names, no wildcard, no IP literal: where the value is set.

paths.description: The paths a value is set on, in the policy's path grammar; absent sets it on every path of the hosts.

auth.description: How the value is sent: the runner contract's auth, in which a definition always names the secret it sets.

declares.description: The secrets the service needs, each by an id the auth names, with a title for a form and, optionally, the variable that gets the placeholder.
